_comment: MedPro site settings for the Provisioning tab. There is deliberately no naming standard here - the tab shows the machine's current name and lets a technician edit it, with only Windows' own rules enforced.

power.description: Balanced plan, display off after 15 minutes on mains, sleep after an hour, laptop lid sleeps on battery only. The screen locks after 15 minutes and requires a password, which is the control that matters on a machine handling candidate and client records.
